info.name: UniUni Platform Client Batches Tracking API

params.name: trackingId
params.description: The shipment tracking ID. Must be 19 characters starting with `UR` (e.g. `UR06250000000000351`) or 19 characters starting with `URB` (batch tracking ID).

items.docs: Retrieves tracking information for a shipment by its tracking ID, including status, recipient, address, dimensions, and scan events.
